title: Nemire
description:
You are the UndeadCollect human essence to summon more undead. Slay the greedy humans and challenge their leaders in Turn-based tactical fights. You are the final boss.

NemireNemire is a daunting union of humanity's mightiest defenders. A symphony of unparalleled skill and cooperation. And they are everything that is wrong with the living. You must raise Undead and destroy greed and power-driven Humans.

Features• Turn-based tactical combat

• Build your squad of ever-evolving undead 

• Random unit traits modify how abilities and standard attacks work 

• Meaningful unit progression

• Meaningful unit progression 

• Combination of handcrafted and procedural environments 

• Gradually ramping difficulty 

• Impactful abilities
description_short: Slay, crush, burn and explode filthy humans for their souls to infuse your squad with new powers and advance for total annihilation. You are the Undead in a turn based tactical RPG controlling a squad.
